name: Pension Haus Elisabeth
beschreibung:
History

The website elisabeth-vent.at welcomes guests to Haus Elisabeth in Vent. The contact page names Anita Scheiber, Franz-Senn-Weg 1, 6458 Vent, telephone +43 5254 8197, a second number +43 5254 81974 and the email elisabeth-vent@aon.at. A year of construction or a history of innkeepers is not published on the page retrieved. soelden.com describes the house as a guesthouse in a quiet location, 100 metres from the ski lifts, and Vent in summer as a starting point for easy family hikes or alpine tours. These 100 metres stand on the tourism page, not as a sentence of the house’s own contact page. Vent belongs to the municipality of Sölden. The older place name only “Sölden” without Vent would confuse the hamlet at the head of the valley with the main village. The Ötztal region remains correct.

Getting there

The house’s own contact page names the address, but no bus line, no parking space and no figure in minutes to the lift. soelden.com adds the 100 metres to the lifts. Guests reach the Bergbahnen Sölden, according to the contact printed there, on +43 5254 5080, and the Ötztal Tourismus GmbH on +43 57200 200. Those are service numbers of the region, not the pension. A detailed approach description was not set out on the arrival page retrieved beyond the address.

Tips

The room page describes comfort rooms in Tyrolean style with bath and WC or shower and WC, satellite TV and in the majority with a balcony. Apartment type A measures 50 square metres and is described for a generous holiday for two. Type B measures 65 square metres for parents with children or friends. Type C likewise measures 65 square metres and is described as a family apartment, with two double rooms, a bathroom with shower and WC and a living room with satellite TV. There is a breakfast room. Guest comments on the page praise the location, the breakfast and the cleanliness. Those are opinions, not additional facilities. Older sentences about a guest parlour with wood decor, a dining room as a restaurant or guaranteed parking spaces do not stand as such on the pages retrieved.

The room price list names all prices per day and excluding visitor’s tax. Rooms including breakfast buffet: summer 55 to 65 euros per person, winter 60 to 75 euros. The single room costs 65 euros in summer and 75 euros in winter. Child reduction of up to 100 percent up to 2 years, group discount on request, short stay of one to two days with a surcharge of 10 to 20 percent. A dog costs 7 euros per day. Apartments, price per apartment: summer 120 to 170 euros, winter 160 to 200 euros, final cleaning 35 euros, breakfast 13 euros per person. At certain times the prices can differ. With the booking the Austrian hotel contract conditions apply. Apartment type A, 50 square metres, has a triple room with a possible extra bed, a balcony and a bathroom with WC, plus a kitchen-living room with a sofa bed, satellite TV and a separate shower with WC. The page names it both for two people and for a family holiday for six. Type B, 65 square metres, consists of a double room with balcony and a triple room, each with bath and WC, separated by a corridor, with a living room with satellite TV in the middle and a separate kitchen.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Elisabeth of Anita Scheiber, Franz-Senn-Weg 1 in Vent, with comfort rooms and three apartment types. Vent is a district of Sölden, not the main village.
